title: ANNOUNCEMENT! Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2024 is coming soon!
body_html:
From 29 November to 1 December 2024, the TOP CUP Academy arena will host the AUTUMN-2024 national tournament of the SUPER CUP ATTP series for table tennis amateurs, in singles, with groups based on the ATTP ranking (senior category) and by age category (children, cadets, juniors).

We are confident that this tournament will be held at the highest level and will help promote sport and a healthy lifestyle, strengthening the importance and role of table tennis in the country’s sporting life.

Come and support our brave players! We will be grateful to every honest player who decides to take part in this wonderful tournament and show their style of play and individual qualities, and we wish them every success, good luck and a winning spirit!
